title: OrderPreparing v1 payload
description: The kitchen started on the order (ADR 0019 PREPARING, entered from CONFIRMED). The fact ADR 0045's «being prepared» milestone and ADR 0184's customer message wait on. Forward edge only: restoring PREPARING from READY is a compensating correction (ADR 0110) and publishes nothing. Carries no customer; who ordered is resolved through an authorized call, because ADR 0029 keeps personal data out of every payload.
